key_observation: Dalian and Liaoning real-estate investment turned sharply negative in 2014; 2015 FAI fell 32.7% and 27.8% respectively
interpretation: Strong evidence of shared regional investment downturn

key_observation: Dalian secondary-industry growth fell from 9.4% in 2013 to 0.9% in 2015; industrial revenue and profit fell 27.4% and 30.7% in 2015
interpretation: Strong evidence that aggregate slowdown concentrated in capital-intensive activity

key_observation: Dalian loan growth fell from 11.6% in 2013 to 6.5% in 2015 while NPL rose from 1.07% to 2.16%
interpretation: Consistent with local financial amplification; aggregate data do not separate supply from demand

key_observation: Comparable central/provincial transfers rose about 4.8% from 2014 to 2015; national platforms and major projects continued
interpretation: No observed collapse in these formal channels during the key slowdown; not proof of unchanged pre-2012 access

key_observation: New Japanese projects fell from 136 in 2012 to 47 in 2015 but actual Japanese FDI remained about US$2.54bn in 2014
interpretation: Supports slow-moving structural headwind more than abrupt 2014 trigger

key_observation: Chongqing retained a positive relative GDP gap and double-digit loan/FAI growth after 2012
interpretation: Supports state-dependent interpretation; not a same-treatment control
